def pos(color):
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']==color:
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            return min(rs),min(cs)
    return None
def act(a,label):
    r=action([a])
    print(label,'bar',pos('b'),'ball',pos('M'),'go',r.get('game_over'),'lc',r.get('level_completed'))
    return r

for _ in range(2): act('LEFT','L')

# to (12,16)
act('RIGHT','R->(12,16)'); act('SPACE','SPACE@(12,16)')
# to start (16,12): 1 LEFT, 1 DOWN
act('LEFT','L->(12,12)'); act('DOWN','D->(16,12)'); act('SPACE','SPACE@(16,12)')
# to center (28,20): 3 DOWN, 2 RIGHT
for _ in range(3): act('DOWN','D')
for _ in range(2): act('RIGHT','R')
print('at',pos('b')); act('SPACE','SPACE@(28,20)')
# click ball & charcoal
act({'action':'MOUSE','row':5,'col':37},'MOUSE ball')
act({'action':'MOUSE','row':2,'col':37},'MOUSE charcoal')
print('timer',[x['pixels'] for x in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if x['color']=='N'])
</parameter>
</function>
